gaps.where: tests/web-threads-b6-26.test.tsx::B6-26 Reopen on the thread > calls reopenTask once with the task and the note, closes, and stays on the thread
gaps.issue: where() === '/t/t1' cannot tell 'not navigated' from 'navigated to /t/t1 again'; navigating again drops location.state.from, so Back to threads loses the project filter, against the contract's 'if James is not already on that thread'.
gaps.fix: Render the thread with state { from: '/?project=p-kanban' }, save, then press Back to threads and assert where() is '/?project=p-kanban'.

gaps.where: B6-26 Reopen: a `Reopen` button in a done task's thread footer
gaps.issue: No test asserts that the thread footer of a task that is not done has no Reopen button, so a footer that always renders Reopen passes.
gaps.fix: Render an in-flight task (e.g. stage main_ci) on the thread and assert queryByRole('button', { name: 'Reopen' }) is null, both there and after the -27 reopen flow.

gaps.where: tests/web-threads-b6-25.test.tsx::B6-25 the History sheet > stamps today, yesterday and older entries as the prototype does
gaps.issue: The stamp tests run in the runner's default locale and an unpinned time zone, so device-locale or UTC formatting passes on some runners.
gaps.fix: Pin a non-UTC TZ and force a non-English, 12-hour default locale, then assert the same stamps.

gaps.where: tests/web-threads-b6-29.test.tsx::B6-29 the archive read in the History sheet > shows no loading status once it has loaded
gaps.issue: The successful archive load never asserts that the error and Retry are absent.
gaps.fix: Assert no Couldn't load text and no Retry button on the loaded and loading cases.

gaps.issue: Only Escape checks focus return on the Reopen sheet; Cancel and Close are not checked.
gaps.fix: Add Cancel and Close cases from the thread footer and a Done card asserting no reopenTask call and focus back on the opener.

gaming_flags.stub_that_passes: After reopenTask resolves, always navigate(`/t/${task.id}`) with no state.
